# Frame UI: complete reference for AI agents

Everything needed to build with Frame in one document. No Python, Node or npm. BASE = the URL this file is served from (or the folder).

---
## 1. Rules and workflow
Frame is a no-build CSS + JS kit for client apps: tight, professional, responsive, accessible and fast.
No Python, Node or npm needed to build with it. Read this file fully before writing UI.

## How you were pointed at it
- **A folder** (`frame/` in the project, or this repo): use the files directly, paths below are relative to it.
- **A URL** (`https://HOST/llms.txt` or any file on that host): HOST is the base. Fetch `BASE/llms-full.txt` for everything in one document, then link the kit straight from BASE:
  ```html
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="BASE/frame.css" crossorigin>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="BASE/themes/pine.css" crossorigin>
  <script src="BASE/frame.js" data-sprite="BASE/icons.svg" defer></script>
  ```
  Page templates are at `BASE/pages/NAME.html`. (The icon sprite loads cross-origin only if the host sends CORS headers: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, jsDelivr and the bundled `_headers` file do. Otherwise copy `icons.svg` next to your page.)

## Principles
- **No build.** Plain HTML, CSS, a little JS. Never add Tailwind, npm, bundlers or frameworks.
- **Write less, copy more.** Start from the closest page in `pages/` (or `starter.html`), edit text and data. Do not invent layouts.
- **Frame classes only.** Use `f-` classes from `components.json`. Do not write new CSS. Per-client styling is colours in `theme.css`.
- **Semantic tokens, never raw colours.** `var(--primary)`, `var(--surface)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--ok)` … never hex in markup.
- **Accessible by default.** Every control has a name. Status is never colour alone. Keep focus rings.
- **Icons from `icons.json` only.** `<svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-NAME"/></svg>`.
- **Minimal HTML.** Inline `style` only for layout tweaks (gap, width). No `!important`.
- **App logic is yours, UI behaviour is the kit's.** Data loading, saving forms and rendering rows go in your own `app.js` (never inline `<script>` blocks). Never re-implement what `data-f-*` already does (modals, tabs, menus, sorting, filtering, wizards, toasts, copy, light/dark).

## Files
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `frame.css`, `frame.js` | The kit. Do not edit per client |
| `themes/NAME.css` | ONE theme, light + dark. Link exactly one. 40 names in `themes.json` (5 Frame + 35 daisyUI) |
| `theme.css` | A client's own colours (copy `theme.example.css`), linked after the theme |
| `components.json` | Every component: classes, modifiers, example markup, daisyUI name |
| `icons.svg`, `icons.json` | 320+ Lucide icons with tags. All are in the sprite |
| `pages/*.html` | 17 page templates + `_overlays.html` (modals, drawers, menus) |
| `starter.html` | Minimal working app shell |
| `preview.html` | Whole kit in one file: open it to see everything |
| `llms-full.txt` | All of the above condensed into one document |

## Workflow
1. Identify the screen type; copy the matching `<section>` from `pages/` (or start from `starter.html`).
2. Look components up in `components.json`; copy their `example`.
3. Wire behaviour with `data-f-*` attributes (header comment of `frame.js`). Never write JS for tabs, modals, menus, sorting, filtering, wizards, toasts, copy, view switching, light/dark.
4. Pick a theme: `<html data-theme="NAME">` + `<link href="themes/NAME.css">`. Light/dark: `data-mode="dark|light"` (works with every theme; with no data-mode a theme shows its natural scheme) or `Frame.setMode('auto')`.
5. **Validate in the browser:** add `data-check` to the frame.js script tag (or open the page with `?check`). The console lists problems and a badge shows the count; `Frame.check()` returns them as an array. Fix every error and warning, then remove `data-check`.
   Optional static check if Python is available: `python3 tools/check.py file.html`.

## Behaviour recipes (no custom JS)
```html
<!-- live search over rows, with an empty state -->
<label class="f-search"><svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-search"/></svg><input data-f-filter="#rows" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search"></label>
<table class="f-table"><tbody id="rows"><tr data-f-text="acme tools active"><td>…</td></tr></tbody></table>
<div class="f-empty" data-f-filter-empty="#rows" hidden>…no matches…</div>
<!-- modal --> <button class="f-btn" data-f-open="#m">Add</button> <dialog class="f-modal" id="m">… <button data-f-close>Cancel</button></dialog>
<!-- toast --> <button data-f-toast="ok|Saved|Supplier added">Save</button>
<!-- light / dark --> <button data-f-mode="dark">Dark</button> <button data-f-mode="light">Light</button>
```

## Rules
- Shell: `<div class="f-app f-app--side">` (sidebar) or `f-app--top`; content in `<main class="f-main">`. `<body class="f-root">`.
- Load order: `frame.css`, then the theme, then `theme.css`.
- Page header: `.f-head` with `.f-h1`, `.f-subtitle`, actions in `.f-head__actions`. One primary button per view.
- Tables inside `.f-tablewrap` (wide tables scroll inside it on phones, nothing else needed); sortable headers `th[data-sort]`.
- Dialogs are native `<dialog class="f-modal|f-drawer">`, opened with `data-f-open="#id"`.
- Forms: `.f-field` > `.f-label[for]` + `.f-input[id]`. Errors: `.f-field--error` + `.f-hint`.
- Status colour only via `f-pill--ok|warn|danger|info` / `f-alert--*`, with text or an icon.
- Charts use `--chart-1..4`, never the brand colour as a series.
- Corners/density: `data-radius="crisp|square"`, `data-density="compact"`. Do not hand-edit radii.
- Accessibility: first in `<body>` put `<a class="f-skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>` and give `<main>` `id="main"`. One `<h1>` per page, card titles are `<h2 class="f-card__title">`, never skip a level. Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`. Tabs, toggles and group rows get their ARIA roles from frame.js: write `data-f-tabs`, do not hand-roll roles.
- Phones (≤600px): the sidebar becomes a bottom tab bar, so keep the sidebar to 5 to 6 destinations (more scroll sideways). Content gets the full width.
- Do not use daisyUI/Tailwind class names (`btn`, `card`, `flex`…): the checker warns with the Frame equivalent.

## Don't
- Add a framework, CSS reset, utility library or a second icon set.
- Hard-code colours, fonts or pixel radii.
- Remove `:focus-visible` styles, or rely on colour alone.
- Edit `frame.css` for one client's request: change `theme.css` or ask.

## Definition of done
The browser check reports no issues; keyboard-only walk-through works; looks right in light and dark at 375px and 1440px.


---
## 2. Themes (link ONE: BASE/themes/NAME.css; every theme has light + dark via data-mode)
- natural light: pine, indigo, ink, terracotta, ocean, acid, autumn, bumblebee, caramellatte, cmyk, corporate, cupcake, cyberpunk, emerald, fantasy, garden, lemonade, light, lofi, nord, pastel, retro, silk, valentine, winter, wireframe
- natural dark: abyss, aqua, black, business, coffee, dark, dim, dracula, forest, halloween, luxury, night, sunset, synthwave

Client colours: copy theme.example.css to theme.css (--color-primary, --color-primary-content, --color-accent, --color-accent-content, --neutral-hue), or paste a daisyUI theme-generator block.
Tokens (daisyUI contract): --color-base-100, --color-base-200, --color-base-300, --color-base-content, --color-primary, --color-primary-content, --color-secondary, --color-secondary-content, --color-accent, --color-accent-content, --color-neutral, --color-neutral-content, --color-info, --color-success, --color-warning, --color-error, --radius-box, --radius-field, --radius-selector

Attributes on <html>: data-theme=any name in themes.json; link themes/NAME.css; data-mode=light|dark, works with every theme (or Frame.setMode("auto")); data-radius=crisp|square; data-layout=floating|docked; data-density=compact

---
## 3. Components (class, modifiers, daisyUI name, example)
### Button
Any action. One primary button per view.
- classes: f-btn
- modifiers: f-btn--primary f-btn--accent f-btn--ghost f-btn--destructive f-btn--sm f-btn--icon f-btn--block
- daisyUI: btn
- example: `<button class="f-btn f-btn--primary">Save</button>`
- a11y: Icon-only buttons need aria-label.

### Badge / pill
Status or count. Pair colour with text or an icon.
- classes: f-pill
- modifiers: f-pill--ok f-pill--warn f-pill--danger f-pill--info f-pill--ai f-pill--brand f-pill--accent f-pill--outline f-pill--dot
- daisyUI: badge
- example: `<span class="f-pill f-pill--ok f-pill--dot">Shipped</span>`

### Card
Container for a group of content.
- classes: f-card
- modifiers: f-card--brand f-card--accent f-card--ai f-card--ok f-card--warn f-card--flush
- daisyUI: card
- example: `<div class="f-card"><div class="f-card__head"><div><h3 class="f-card__title">Title</h3><p class="f-card__sub">Sub</p></div></div>…</div>`

### Tabs
Switch panels. Container needs data-f-tabs; children aria-controls.
- classes: f-tabs f-tab
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: tabs
- example: `<div class="f-tabs" data-f-tabs role="tablist"><button class="f-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="p1">One</button></div>`
- a11y: role=tablist/tab, aria-selected.

### Segmented control
Small either/or choice.
- classes: f-seg
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: join, tabs
- example: `<span class="f-seg"><button aria-pressed="true">Month</button><button aria-pressed="false">Week</button></span>`

### Chips
Single-select filter chips.
- classes: f-chips f-chip
- modifiers: f-chip__n
- daisyUI: badge, tabs
- example: `<div class="f-chips" data-f-chips><button class="f-chip" aria-pressed="true">All <span class="f-chip__n">12</span></button></div>`

### Table
Data table. Wrap in f-tablewrap. Sortable with th[data-sort].
- classes: f-table f-tablewrap
- modifiers: f-table--dense f-table--zebra f-table--sticky
- daisyUI: table
- example: `<div class="f-tablewrap"><table class="f-table"><thead><tr><th data-sort>Order</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>…</td></tr></tbody></table></div>`
- a11y: Use <th scope> and a caption or aria-label for complex tables.

### Input
Text-like input inside a field.
- classes: f-input f-field f-label f-hint
- modifiers: f-field--error
- daisyUI: input, fieldset, label
- example: `<div class="f-field"><label class="f-label" for="e">Email</label><input id="e" class="f-input" type="email"></div>`
- a11y: Every control needs a label (for/id) or aria-label.

### Textarea
Multi-line input.
- classes: f-textarea
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: textarea
- example: `<textarea class="f-textarea" aria-label="Notes"></textarea>`

### Checkbox

- classes: f-check
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: checkbox
- example: `<label class="f-row"><input type="checkbox" class="f-check">Remember me</label>`

### Radio

- classes: f-radio
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: radio
- example: `<label class="f-row"><input type="radio" name="r" class="f-radio">Option</label>`

### Switch
On/off setting. Always give it a name.
- classes: f-switch
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: toggle
- example: `<input type="checkbox" class="f-switch" aria-label="Email alerts">`

### Modal
Native dialog. Open with data-f-open.
- classes: f-modal f-sheet__head f-sheet__body f-sheet__foot
- modifiers: f-modal--sm
- daisyUI: modal
- example: `<dialog class="f-modal" id="m">…</dialog> <button data-f-open="#m">Open</button>`
- a11y: Native dialog: focus trap and Esc included.

### Drawer
Side panel dialog.
- classes: f-drawer
- modifiers: f-drawer--left f-drawer--sm
- daisyUI: drawer
- example: `<dialog class="f-drawer" id="d">…</dialog>`

### Dropdown menu
Action menu. Trigger has data-f-menu.
- classes: f-menu f-menu__item
- modifiers: f-menu--pop f-menu__label f-menu__sep f-menu__item--danger
- daisyUI: dropdown, menu
- example: `<button data-f-menu="#mn" class="f-btn">More</button><div class="f-menu" id="mn" role="menu"><button class="f-menu__item">Edit</button></div>`

### Alert
Inline message.
- classes: f-alert
- modifiers: f-alert--ok f-alert--warn f-alert--danger f-alert--info
- daisyUI: alert
- example: `<div class="f-alert f-alert--warn" role="alert">…</div>`

### Toast
Transient message. Frame.toast({kind,title,text}) or data-f-toast="ok|Title|Text".
- classes: f-toast
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: toast
- example: `<button data-f-toast="ok|Saved|Done">Save</button>`

### Progress
Linear progress. Set width inline.
- classes: f-progress f-meter
- modifiers: f-meter--lg f-meter--warn f-meter--danger
- daisyUI: progress
- example: `<div class="f-progress"><i style="width:40%"></i></div>`

### Steps
Process or wizard steps.
- classes: f-steps f-step
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: steps
- example: `<div class="f-steps"><div class="f-step" data-state="done"><span class="f-step__dot"></span><b>Quote</b></div></div>`

### Timeline
Vertical history.
- classes: f-tl f-tl__item
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: timeline
- example: `<div class="f-tl"><div class="f-tl__item" data-state="done">…</div></div>`

### Avatar
User image or initials.
- classes: f-avatar
- modifiers: f-avatar--lg f-avatars
- daisyUI: avatar
- example: `<span class="f-avatar">PS</span>`

### Skeleton
Loading placeholder.
- classes: f-skel
- modifiers: f-skel--circle
- daisyUI: skeleton
- example: `<div class="f-skel" style="height:16px"></div>`

### Empty state
No data yet or no results.
- classes: f-empty f-empty__icon
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: hero
- example: `<div class="f-empty"><span class="f-empty__icon">…</span><h3>No orders</h3><p>…</p></div>`

### List item
Row with icon, text and action.
- classes: f-li f-list
- modifiers: f-li--plain f-li__icon--ok f-li__icon--danger
- daisyUI: list
- example: `<div class="f-li"><span class="f-li__icon">…</span><div class="f-li__body"><div class="f-li__title">Title</div></div></div>`

### Key-value list
Label/value pairs.
- classes: f-kv
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: stats
- example: `<dl class="f-kv"><dt>Status</dt><dd>Open</dd></dl>`

### Stat / KPI
Headline number with delta.
- classes: f-kpis f-kpi f-num f-delta
- modifiers: f-num--lg f-num--xl
- daisyUI: stat
- example: `<div class="f-kpi">…</div>`

### Kanban board
Drag cards between columns.
- classes: f-board f-col f-kcard
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: (none)
- example: `<div class="f-board"><div class="f-col">…</div></div>`

### Command palette
Ctrl/Cmd+K search dialog.
- classes: f-cmd
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: (none)
- example: `<dialog class="f-cmd" id="cmd">…</dialog>`

### Calendar
Month grid with events.
- classes: f-cal
- modifiers: f-cal__ev--ok f-cal__ev--warn f-cal__ev--danger f-cal__ev--info
- daisyUI: calendar
- example: `See pages/calendar.html`

### Search
Search field with icon.
- classes: f-search
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: input
- example: `<label class="f-search"><svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-search"/></svg><input placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search"></label>`

### Icon
Lucide SVG sprite. Names in icons.json.
- classes: f-i
- modifiers: f-i--sm f-i--lg
- daisyUI: (svg)
- example: `<svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-search"/></svg>`
- a11y: Decorative: no label. Meaningful: wrap in labelled button.

### Logo
Three slots: sidebar, top bar, sign-in.
- classes: f-logo
- modifiers: f-logo--mark f-logo--lg
- daisyUI: (none)
- example: `<a class="f-logo" data-logo="full"></a>`

### Live filter / search
Filter rows, list items or cards as you type. No JavaScript to write.
- classes: f-search
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: (none)
- example: `<input data-f-filter="#rows" aria-label="Search"> <table class="f-table"><tbody id="rows"><tr data-f-text="acme tools active">…</tr></tbody></table> <div class="f-empty" data-f-filter-empty="#rows" hidden>No matches</div>`
- a11y: Give the input a label. Optional chips: data-f-filter-cat; count: data-f-filter-count.

### Light / dark switch
Switch mode for any theme without custom JS.
- classes: f-btn
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: theme-controller, swap
- example: `<button class="f-btn" data-f-mode="dark">Dark</button> <button class="f-btn" data-f-mode="light">Light</button>`
- a11y: Use real buttons with text or aria-label.

### Select
Native select styled like an input.
- classes: f-select
- modifiers: (none)
- daisyUI: select
- example: `<div class="f-field"><label class="f-label" for="c">Category</label><select id="c" class="f-select"><option>Tools</option></select></div>`
- a11y: Label required.

---
## 4. Behaviour (frame.js, all data-attributes)
```
frame.js — optional behaviour for Frame UI. No dependencies, no build.
   Everything is driven by data-attributes, so pages stay plain HTML.

   Check      <script src="frame.js" data-check defer>  or ?check in the URL: console + badge. Frame.check() returns the list
   Base URL   [data-f-base]  replaces {BASE} in its text and data-f-copy with this page's folder URL
   Sprite     <script src="frame.js" data-sprite="icons.svg" defer>   auto-inject the icon sprite (http only)
   Attribute  data-f-set-attr="#grid > *|data-mode|dark"  set an attribute on every match (value - removes it)
   Mode       Frame.setMode('light'|'dark'|'auto')   [data-f-mode="dark"] on any button; works with every theme
   Overlays   data-f-open="#id"        open a <dialog class="f-drawer|f-modal">
              data-f-close             close the dialog it sits in
              data-f-menu="#id"        toggle a .f-menu (data-align="end|center")
              Frame.toast({kind,title,text})   data-f-toast="ok|Title|Text"
              ⌘K / Ctrl+K              opens #cmd if present
   Tabs       [data-f-tabs] > [aria-controls="panelId"]
   Wizard     [data-f-wizard]  [data-f-step]  [data-f-next] [data-f-prev] [data-f-finish]
   Tables     [data-f-select="#bulkBar"]  [data-f-all]  [data-f-row]   select + bulk bar
              th[data-sort]  (+ td[data-v] for raw values)             sorting
              tr.f-group[aria-expanded]                                 collapsible groups
              [data-f-expand]                                           expandable rows
              [data-f-cols="#tableId"] > input[data-f-col="name"]       column visibility
   Filter     <input data-f-filter="#rows">  filters the children of #rows (a <tbody>, list or grid) as you type.
              Give each child data-f-text="searchable words". Optional: [data-f-filter-cat="#rows"] chips (children
              carry data-cat), [data-f-filter-count="#rows"] shows the visible count, [data-f-filter-empty="#rows"] [hidden]
              is shown when nothing matches (put your empty state there).
   Misc       [data-f-chips]  single-select chips      [data-f-remove]  remove filter chip
              [data-f-view="#id"]                     show one of several [data-f-viewitem] siblings (auth views)
              [data-f-theme="name"]                   set <html data-theme> (theme gallery); fires 'f-theme'
              [data-f-copy="text"]                     [data-f-dismiss] close an alert
              [data-f-toggle="#id"]                    show/hide an element
              .f-board  (cards .f-kcard[draggable])    drag between columns
```

## 5. Page templates (fetch BASE/pages/NAME.html, copy the <section>)
- dashboard: KPI cards, hero, attention list, activity
- orders: Filtered table, chips, bulk actions, drawer
- detail: Record detail with steps, tabs, timeline
- pipeline: Kanban
- inbox: Threads + conversation
- reports: Charts
- tables: Grouping, inline edit, column picker
- form: Wizard and form sections
- calendar: Month calendar
- notifications: Feed with filters
- settings: Branding, team, API keys
- profile: Account and security
- billing: Plans, usage, invoices
- onboarding: Checklist
- errors: 404 403 500 maintenance offline
- ui: All overlays and controls
- auth: Sign in, up, forgot, 2FA

## 7. Minimal working page (starter.html)
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="pine">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Client app</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='8' fill='%23144'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="frame.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="themes/pine.css">   <!-- ONE theme file (light + dark). 40 to choose from in themes/ -->
  <script src="frame.js" data-sprite="icons.svg" defer></script>
</head>
<body class="f-root">
  <a class="f-skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>
<!-- STARTER: sidebar shell + one page. Serve over http (any static server) so the icon sprite loads.
     Copy sections from pages/*.html. Validate: add data-check to the frame.js tag below and read the console. -->
<div class="f-app f-app--side">
  <aside class="f-side">
    <div class="f-side__head"><a class="f-logo" href="#" aria-label="Home"><span class="f-logo__mark">A</span><span class="f-logo__word">Acme</span></a></div>
    <nav class="f-nav" aria-label="Main">
      <a href="#" aria-current="page"><svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-layout-grid"/></svg><span>Overview</span></a>
      <a href="#"><svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-inbox"/></svg><span>Orders</span><span class="f-nav__n">12</span></a>
      <a href="#"><svg class="f-i"><use href="#i-users"/></svg><span>Customers</span></a>
```

## 8. Validate
Add data-check to the frame.js <script> (or open the page with ?check). Console + badge list problems; Frame.check() returns them. Fix all, then remove data-check.
